knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure requires using only credentials issued to you, never tailgating or sharing codes, and checking the access instructions in the approved system.
If access, consent or authority is unclear, the affected work is paused, the nominated contact is told and the reason is documented.
The workplace procedure says to use only credentials issued to you, and never to tailgate through secured doors or share access codes.

practicalCriteria: Uses authorised access, locates emergency arrangements, recognises restricted zones and records access exceptions.
Recognises and escalates unsafe or out-of-scope work
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 2: Complete the required induction before work starts, including the evacuation assembly point, restricted areas, emergency contacts and incident reporting route.

Record of procedure step 4: Do not tailgate through secured doors. If an unfamiliar contractor offers to hold a secure door, decline and use your own authorised access, and report an unexpected visitor if site policy requires it.
Record of procedure step 5: If access fails, notify the nominated contact and record the delay.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 3 is not done: Use only the credentials issued to you, and never share access codes.

Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: Do not tailgate through secured doors. If an unfamiliar contractor offers to hold a secure door, decline and use your own authorised access, and report an unexpected visitor if site policy requires it.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Before acting, confirm the authorisation, the hazards and the person responsible for escalation.
